body.off: The editor could not load. Reload the page; nothing has been changed.
body.placeholder: Write here, or type / for more
body.wayOutBlock: This opens as Markdown, since the editor would change {element} (block {path}). Nothing has been changed.
body.wayOutLost: This opens as Markdown, since the editor would change the text. Nothing has been changed.
body.wayOutRead: This opens as Markdown, since the editor cannot read all of it. Nothing has been changed.
body.wayOutOff: This opens as Markdown, since the editor would rewrite it and the early check that could prove the meaning stays is off. Nothing has been changed.
body.checkOff: The early check is off, since it could not load. You can write and save as usual; anything the site cannot publish is reported when it is published.
body.refused: The site cannot publish this, so nothing has been saved. Your text is still here. What to change:
body.keptList: A list with pictures, kept as Markdown
body.keptHtml: A structured table or raw HTML, kept as Markdown
body.keptOther: Kept as Markdown, since it is not on offer here
body.anchorHint: a to z, digits, hyphens and underscores
body.imageCaptionHint: A caption, if it needs one
body.imageRemoveAsk: Remove this image from the text?
body.imageRemoveAside: The image library stays as it is.
body.noAlt: Describe the image for those who cannot see it.
body.galleryRemoveAsk: Remove this gallery from the text?
body.galleryCaptionHint: A caption for the whole gallery, if it needs one
body.embedNoAddress: Paste the address of what to embed.
body.embedRemoveAsk: Remove this embed from the text?
body.libraryEmpty: The library holds no images yet. Upload the first.
body.libraryNoneFound: No image in the library matches.
body.libraryFailed: The library could not be read just now.
body.uploadFailed: The image could not be uploaded just now. Nothing has been added, and your text is still here.
body.element.heading: a heading
image.main: The main image is used, unless you choose another.
image.cannotShow: The image cannot be shown here
image.notImage: The file is no image the site can use.
image.notAdded: The file could not be added just now.
structure.heading: Heading
structure.rewrites: This file is written otherwise than the structure field would write it. It is written anew when you change something.
structure.unreadable: The file cannot be read as a structure: {reason}. It is shown as Markdown.
structure.formNote: The site's developer makes each form; an editor chooses among them.
structure.postListNote: Taken from the posts at every publish. Change the posts, and the list follows.
structure.nothingHere: This level has no settings of its own. Choose something in it.
structure.nothingToSet: There is nothing to set here.
structure.listNote: {n} items. Choose an item to change it.
structure.start: Click a text in the preview, search, or choose a row below.
structure.where: Where you are on the page
structure.noHits: No text on the page holds that.
structure.find: Find a text on the page
structure.markdownHint: This is the file as the repository holds it. Each level is a directive, and its fence is longer the more levels it holds.
preview.title: The page as it would look
preview.off: The preview is not answering. This is about the preview alone: your text is still here, and can be saved.
preview.refused: The site cannot publish this yet, so the page below is the last good one. What to change:
preview.refusedNoPage: The site cannot publish this yet, so there is no page to show. What to change:
preview.stoppedLink: On the public site, this link goes to {to}.
preview.stoppedWindow: On the public site, this opens {to} in a new tab.
preview.stoppedForm: On the public site, this form is sent to {to}.
preview.stoppedScript: On the public site, this page goes on to {to} by itself.
preview.stoppedHistory: On the public site, this takes a step in the browser's history.
preview.thenLoops: That address redirects round in a circle, so a visitor never arrives.
preview.leads: On the public site, {address} redirects to {to} ({status}), so a visitor never sees this page.
preview.leadsRound: On the public site, {address} redirects round in a circle, so a visitor never sees this page.
preview.noPage: This has no page of its own.
preview.windowIdle: Open a page or an article in the editor to see it here.
preview.windowGone: The editor has been closed or is loading again. Open the window from the editor to see the preview here again.
preview.windowClosed: The preview is to be shown in a window of its own, which is not open.
publishing.title: Title
publishing.liveWarned: Live on the site, with something to look at:
publishing.being: Being published, which takes at most about a minute.
publishing.beingShown: Being published, which takes at most about a minute. Until then visitors see the last version.
publishing.draft: A draft, which is not on the site.
publishing.draftShown: A draft, on its way off the site.
publishing.stillShown: Visitors still see the last version.
publishing.notShown: It is not on the site.
publishing.unknown: Cannot tell how publishing stands just now.
parts.scheduledAhead: A scheduled post is published at its moment, which needs to lie ahead. Change the date and time, or choose another status.
form.title: Title
form.slugHint: The last part of the address. Made from the title if left empty.
form.name: Name
form.seoFollows: Left empty, the template for this type of post decides.
form.breadcrumbHint: Instead of the title, when a shorter name fits better. The levels themselves follow from where the post sits.
form.headline: Main headline
form.workingNameHint: Shown in the lists of posts. The breadcrumb, and the slug of a new post, are made from it.
form.caption: Caption
form.libraryHint: Copied into a post when the image is chosen there, where it can then be changed for that use.
form.label: Label
form.labelHint: The post's title, if left empty.
form.otherPathHint: The path from the site's root, starting with /, such as /old-page/. Not a whole web address: the site can only answer at addresses of its own.
form.otherPathPattern: Write a path starting with /, such as /old-page/, not a whole web address.
form.urlHint: Only for an entry that does not lead to a post.
